name: pam_mkhomedir
detailed_description: Session setup module that automatically creates home directories for new users upon first login. Particularly useful with LDAP or other network authentication backends. Uses skeleton directory to populate home with default files.

parameters.skel: Directory to copy skeleton files from

notes:
Automatically creates home directory for new users (e.g., LDAP users)
